map.由摆长与重力加速度，按 T = 2π√(L/g) 计算小角度单摆周期。: Compute the small-angle period of a simple pendulum from its length and gravity with T = 2π√(L/g).
map.适用条件：小角度（θ<5°~10°）；与摆球质量无关。: Applicable condition: small angle (θ<5°~10°); independent of the bob mass.
map.用单摆实验测量重力加速度或调校摆钟。: Measure gravity or calibrate pendulum clocks with pendulum experiments.
map.仅小角度（<15°）近似，大角度周期更长。: Only an approximation for small angles (<15°); the period is longer at large angles.
map.与摆球质量有关吗？: Does it depend on the bob mass?
map.无关。周期只取决于摆长与重力加速度（等时性）。: No. The period depends only on length and gravity (isochronism).
